requirement_text: The system shall allow the user to create a new project by providing the project name.
The system shall allow the user to provide the low-level document path when creating a new project.
The user shall be able to cancel the new project creation process and return to the previous state at any time.
The system shall create the project in Trace mode using the provided input.
The user shall be able to select a project name from a list of saved projects to load.
The user shall be able to activate the Save function to save the current project data and status.
The user shall be able to generate and save an RTM report.
The user shall be able to activate a Kill Hidden Links function to remove elements not currently displayed.
The system shall allow multiple projects to be open at the same time.
The user shall be able to create and remove links between low-level and high-level requirements.
The system shall display the list of candidate links based on tracing and permit feedback and filtering.
The system shall mark the project as completed and not permit further changes once tracing is finished.
The system shall display to the user the percentage level of satisfaction for each link.
The system shall color-code the satisfaction status of each candidate link.
